content:
liam (Procurement): FYI MLOpsCorp sent our renewal quote for ModelWatch. Numbers look up ~28% vs last year. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example

maya (Finance): Can you drop the quote here or screenshot? need to reconcile vs actual usage before we sign.

liam (Procurement): Pasted key lines from the PDF below. vendor attached a summary and tiered pricing.

vendor-alex (MLOpsCorp): Hi all — quick clarifier: the +28% reflects added observability modules (trace + anomaly) and bumped support SLA. We can separate the observability add-on if you only want core inference monitoring.

zoe (Platform Eng): short question — is that +observability per-host or per-inference? our traffic spiky, per-host might be cheaper.

vendor-alex (MLOpsCorp): observability is per-inference for cloud plan, per-host for on-prem. Quick snippet of the quoted tiers: ```
Core Plan: $6k/mo (up to 50M inferences)
Observability add-on: $0.0025 / inference or $3k/mo flat (hosted customers choose best fit)
Enterprise SLA: +15%
Multi-year 2yr commit: -12%
Pilot (3mo, up to 10M inf): 60% off add-on
```

priya (SRE): If on-prem switches to per-host, does that require a license key rotation process? also want to know about data retention / encryption defaults.

vendor-alex (MLOpsCorp): on-prem uses license token + local storage. retention configurable; we default to 90 days encrypted at rest. KMS integrations available.

maya (Finance): For reconciliation I need last 12 months spend by product line. liam can you confirm if ModelWatch costs were split across platform and product teams?

liam (Procurement): Historically it was charged to infra (cost center 4100) but usage spike in Q4 was attributed to Search team. I'll pull the internal billing and map to invoice numbers.

zoe (Platform Eng): We should push to change pricing from per-inference to a committed throughput band if possible. spikes killed predictability last quarter. negotiating commit + burst seems ideal.

liam (Procurement): Agreed. Proposed negotiation asks to vendor: 1) separate observability line-item 2) committed throughput band + burst pricing 3) pilot extension and invoice credit 4) multi-year discount or true-up clause.

vendor-alex (MLOpsCorp): We can do 1–3. For multi-year we can offer 10–12% depending on commit. Also can add a true-up quarterly with cap. Renewal cutoff to lock pricing is 2026-04-15 per legal.

maya (Finance): Please include sample invoice and put proposed contract terms (commit levels) into the spreadsheet. i'll need GL codes and payment terms (net30 vs net45) for PO.

liam (Procurement): Will do. Next steps: i'll ask vendor for a revised quote with separated lines and a commit/burst proposal, plus a 90-day pilot extension. If we get that, finance can review for approval.

zoe (Platform Eng): if vendor offers pilot extension, i'll spin up limited traffic test and measure cost per-inference under commit band.

maya (Finance): Sounds good. ping me once the revised quote is in. :+1:

vendor-alex (MLOpsCorp): Thanks — sending revised quote by EOD tomorrow with pilot terms.

liam (Procurement): Thanks everyone. I'll update the sheet and tag finance once revised quote lands.
